note: Shoshone NF (Clarks Fork RD) campground on the banks of the Clarks Fork of the Yellowstone River, on the Chief Joseph Scenic Highway (WY-296) about 4 miles south of the Beartooth Highway and 24 miles from Yellowstone's Northeast Entrance. Mixed conifer forest; grizzly country, so food storage is required and bear boxes are provided. Water from a hand pump; on-site fees in cash or check. --Claude
